title: 'Nuclear Weapons Gap' Premieres Sunday at 9 p.m.
description: The Newsmax original documentary “Newsfront: Nuclear Weapons Gap,” premiering Sunday at 9 p.m. ET, examines Pentagon estimates that within a decade China and Russia combined could possess twice as many strategic nuclear warheads as the United States. The film argues that America must urgently modernize its aging nuclear triad to maintain credible deterrence, especially as nuclear threats now extend beyond Russia and China to include Iran and North Korea, straining the U.S. nuclear umbrella that protects treaty allies. Writer, director, and co-executive producer Jack Thomas Smith emphasizes that while modernization will be costly, continued life extensions of existing systems are no longer sufficient. Co-executive producer Mandy Del Rio Smith highlights what she sees as widespread public unawareness about the growing nuclear gap and its potential dangers. Featuring insights from national security experts and military leaders, the documentary underscores that the ultimate objective of a strong nuclear force is not to fight a nuclear war, but to prevent one from ever occurring.
